```{r load_libraries, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE}
library(data.table)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggpointdensity)
library(ggpubr)
library(tidyr)
library(stringr)
library(pROC)
library(ROCR)
library(ggrepel)
library(immunarch)
theme_set(theme_classic())

data_dir   = "~/research/data/TCR/TCGA/_processed_data"
result_dir = "~/research/data/TCR/TCGA/_results"

TCR_dir = "../../data_gene_expression_signature/Zheng_2021_processed"
```

# Read in data

## read mutation information
```{r fig.width=5, fig.height=3}
mut_info = fread("../data/GSE156728_bulk_Exome.mutation.txt.gz")
dim(mut_info)
mut_info[1:2,1:21]

tp = table(mut_info$patient)
tp = as.data.frame(tp)
names(tp) = c("patient", "mutation_freq")
tp = cbind(tp, str_split_fixed(tp$patient, "\\.", n=2))
names(tp)[3:4] = c("cancer_type", "patient_id")
dim(tp)
tp[1:5,]

table(tp$cancer_type)

ggplot(tp, aes(x= cancer_type, y = log10(mutation_freq), fill=cancer_type)) +
  geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.7, outlier.shape = NA) + 
  geom_jitter(width = 0.2, alpha = 0.8) + 
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))  

mut_info[,key:=paste(Gene, CHROM, POS, REF, ALT, sep=":")]

tm = table(mut_info$key)
length(tm)
table(tm)
sort(tm, decreasing = TRUE)[1:10]

tg = table(mut_info$Gene)
length(tg)
table(tg)
sort(tg, decreasing = TRUE)[1:20]
```

## Match patient information

Obtain library ID of each patient. 

```{r}
sam_info = fread(file.path(TCR_dir, "../Zheng_2021/GSE156728", 
                           "GSE156728_metadata.txt.gz"))
dim(sam_info)
sam_info[1:2,]

table(sam_info$loc)
table(sam_info$platform)
sam_info = sam_info[sam_info$loc == "T" & sam_info$platform == "10X",]

tb_patient_cell = table(sam_info$patient)
length(tb_patient_cell)
summary(as.numeric(tb_patient_cell))

table(tp$patient %in% sam_info$patient)

sam_lib = unique(sam_info[,c("cancerType", "patient", "libraryID", "platform")])
dim(sam_lib)

sam_lib = sam_lib[sam_lib$patient %in% tp$patient,]
dim(sam_lib)
sam_lib[1:2,]

table(sam_lib$cancerType)
table(table(sam_lib$patient))
```


## Construct mutation data matirx

```{r}
tb_mut = table(mut_info$key)
length(tb_mut)
sort(tb_mut, decreasing = TRUE)[1:9]

table(tb_mut > 1)

dim(mut_info)
mut_info[1:2,c(1:10,77)]
mut_info$value = 1

mut_mat = reshape2::acast(mut_info, key ~ patient, value.var="value", 
                         fun.aggregate=sum, drop=FALSE)
dim(mut_mat)
mut_mat[1:2,1:3]
table(c(mut_mat))

colnames(mut_mat) = gsub(".", "-", colnames(mut_mat), fixed = TRUE)
colnames(mut_mat) = paste0(colnames(mut_mat), "-T")
mut_mat[1:2,1:5]
```


## Read in TCR data
```{r message = FALSE, warning=FALSE}
tcr = fread(file.path(TCR_dir, "TCR.txt.gz"))

dim(tcr)
tcr[1:2,]

table(sam_lib$libraryID %in% tcr$library.id)
table(tcr$library.id %in% sam_lib$libraryID)

tcr = tcr[library.id %in% sam_lib$libraryID,]
dim(tcr)
```

## Prepare TCR data matrix

```{r}
dim(tcr)
tcr[1:2,]

tcr[,key_tcr:=paste(CDR3, library.id, sep=":")]
t_key = table(tcr$key_tcr)
summary(as.numeric(t_key))

sort(t_key, decreasing=TRUE)[1:5]
tcr[key_tcr == "CAVIRTGANNLFF:CSVEGGASYEQYF:RC-P20190923-T",][1:5,]

table(is.na(tcr$cdr3_alpha), is.na(tcr$cdr3_beta))
table(tcr$cdr3_alpha == "", tcr$cdr3_beta == "")

tcr$value = 1

TA_mat = reshape2::acast(tcr, cdr3_alpha ~ library.id, value.var="value", 
                         fun.aggregate=sum)
TB_mat = reshape2::acast(tcr, cdr3_beta ~ library.id, value.var="value", 
                         fun.aggregate=sum)

dim(TA_mat)
TA_mat[1:2,1:3]
TA_mat["CAVIRTGANNLFF", "RC-P20190923-T"]
summary(c(TA_mat))

dim(TB_mat)
TB_mat[1:2,1:3]
summary(c(TB_mat))

stopifnot(all(colnames(TA_mat) == colnames(TB_mat)))
```

## Write out data
```{r}
table(colnames(TA_mat) %in% colnames(mut_mat))
mut_mat = mut_mat[,match(colnames(TA_mat), colnames(mut_mat))]

mut_dt = data.table(mutation=rownames(mut_mat), mut_mat)
dim(mut_dt)
mut_dt[1:2,1:3]

fwrite(mut_dt, "../data/mut_dat_matrix.tsv", sep="\t")

TA_dt = data.table(TCR=rownames(TA_mat), TA_mat)
dim(TA_dt)
TA_dt[1:2,1:3]

fwrite(TA_dt, "../data/TCR_alpha_dat_matrix.tsv", sep="\t")

TB_dt = data.table(TCR=rownames(TB_mat), TB_mat)
dim(TB_dt)
TB_dt[1:2,1:3]

fwrite(TB_dt, "../data/TCR_beta_dat_matrix.tsv", sep="\t")

```


## redraw 
```{r fig.width=3, fig.height=2.7}
dim(tp)
tp[1:5,]

patients = str_remove(names(mut_dt)[-1], "-T$")
patients = gsub("-", ".", patients)
table(tp$patient %in% patients)
tp = tp[tp$patient %in% patients,]

ggplot(tp, aes(x= cancer_type, y = log10(mutation_freq), fill=cancer_type)) +
  geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.7, outlier.shape = NA) + 
  geom_jitter(width = 0.2, alpha = 0.8) + 
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)) + 
  xlab("Cancer Type") + ylab("log10(mutation burden)") + 
  theme(legend.position = "none")
```
